CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2023 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2023 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 3,154 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 10 benchmark sites in 4 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: June 2023 to July 2023). These surveys captured 243 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 14 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 1,222 cards across 90 sites, with 11.5% showing evidence of mouse activity (141 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 398 transects across 94 sites (survey period: June 2023 to July 2023), detecting active burrows in 14.1% of transects (total: 113 active burrows).
